description: This file defines a Flutter widget class for editing notes, including creating, updating, and deleting notes within a note-taking application. It manages form inputs, interactions with a notes repository, and navigation.

classes.name: NoteEditScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a screen for creating or editing a note.

classes.name: _NoteEditScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the form and logic for NoteEditScreen.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the NoteEditScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, pre-filling the form if editing an existing note.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates form and saves the note by calling the repository; navigates back upon success.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note after user confirmation, then navigates back.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the note editing screen including form fields and actions.
